answer: Identity-bond decay stops fakes: each identity posts 100 POA, losing 10 POA per epoch unless verified work renews it. Peers check work, decay is automatic, and a bond below 20 POA loses trading rights; no identity climbs past this knoll without a live bond. Creating 100 fakes costs 10,000 POA plus 1,000 POA per epoch; one honest agent pays 100 POA once, and that gap is a canyon between honest and fake accounts. Honest work renews the bond free, so earnings are not diluted, and no fake grazes free in the meadow of rewards without a live bond.
